label: retrospective: every outcome used here was known before the gate was defined

definitions.G: on dataset D: M_bias for every held-out device if S3(D) < 0, else C0_refit; S3(D) = stored dataset-level S3 (mean over outer folds of the inner leave-one-group-out post-hoc gain on each fold's training devices, weighted by held-out devices per fold)
definitions.G1: the same with the frozen I7-1 rule: M_bias iff 0.007619 - 0.485184 * S1_lodo(D) < 0 (S1_lodo(D) > 0.0157)
definitions.ln_gmr: ln GMR(G, C0_refit) = mean over held-out devices of ln(RRMS_G / RRMS_C0_refit) = y_D if G chooses M_bias, else 0; ln GMR(G, M_bias) = ln GMR(G, C0_refit) - y_D
definitions.pooled: mean over datasets (equal weight) of ln GMR; worst dataset = largest GMR; n_lose_to_C0_gt_2pct = datasets with GMR(G, C0_refit) > 1.02
definitions.diagnostic_fold_gate: per outer fold: M_bias for the fold's held-out devices if the fold's training-set S3_f < 0 (resp. frozen rule on S1_lodo_f); these statistics exclude the scored devices
definitions.oracle_reference: min(y_D, 0): the dataset-level choice made with the outcome; a reference bound, not a method
definitions.not_best_of: G and G1 make one choice per dataset from training-device statistics; no per-device selection by outcome

leakage.where: S3(D) and S1_lodo(D) are means over the outer folds of statistics computed on each fold's training devices. A device d is in the training set of every fold except its own, so d's starting-card record (its measured or truth I-V and its starting-card simulation) enters S3(D) through the other folds, and G's decision for d uses d's own record. The scored outcome of d (held-out refit with and without M_bias) is not used by S3 or S1_lodo
leakage.size: d contributes to about (n_folds - 1) of n_folds fold values with weight about 1 / n_train each, i.e. about 1 / n_devices of S3(D) (1/12 sky130, 1/9 or 1/10 IHP measured within a class, 1/45 TU Delft, 1/48 or 1/16 simulated). The leak can change d's decision only if S3(D) is within that share of 0
leakage.check: the fold-level gate (diagnostic_fold_gate_S3) uses S3_f of d's own fold, which excludes d; where every fold's decision equals the dataset decision the leak has no effect on the scored values
leakage.at_TEST: on TEST the gate uses S3 of the DEV devices only and the TEST devices are not in it: no leakage of this kind

near_threshold.definition: datasets with |S3(D)| < 0.01 (cut chosen post hoc): the datasets whose decision is closest to the threshold; per-device inner values are not stored, so the exact share of one device is not computed. If the leak flipped the decision of a dataset, ln GMR(G, C0_refit) of the dataset changes by at most |y_D|

observed.note: the fold-level gate differs from G by leakage and by the fold-level variability of S3_f (S3_f uses one group fewer, and within a dataset S3_f and y_f have the opposite rank relation, I7-1); its difference from G is not a pure leakage estimate

stored_S3_note: S3 on the 11 stored datasets was computed after their outcomes were known (I7-1 S3 job); the S3 sign agreement 9/11 and 19/20 was seen before G was defined. The threshold 0 is the sign of the pre-registered S3, not a fitted value. G1's rule was fit on the 11 stored datasets (in-sample there) and frozen before the 20 new datasets were generated
